_comment: EXAMPLE per-device travel-router identity for modem-tune. The engine ships this generic template; real device identity is private DATA at <data-root>/config/modem.json. Each device: transport (gl_modem|ubus), host, tac (8-digit device-class code), factory_imei (original 15-digit IMEI, the revert target). transport/host are per-device metadata; the active SSH target is MODEM_HOST in .env -- reserved for future multi-host support.
